pnpm.//: Security overrides for transitive deps. pnpm honours these ONLY in the root manifest — an `overrides` block in a workspace member is silently ignored, which is how cookie/esbuild regressed to vulnerable versions during the website import. cookie <0.7.0: CVE-2024-47764. esbuild <=0.24.2: GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99.
